item.tib: ma rgyud rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshig don gter gyi spa skong mchod byang bkod pa me tog chun po'i phreng ba rgyan gyi mchod pa'i sprin dpung
item.coloph: ma rgyud lha grangs kyi rjes su rol pa sde tshogs dgongs don dang / gnas tshul dngos grub dang*/ gsang sngags bshad pa nyer bsdus dngos grub kyi 'dod gsol phyag rgya bzhi'i las sbyor dang / dpe don mtshungs pa'i tshig don/ sku lnga phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang gi brjod bya dang / dkyil 'khor gnas kyi tshig dang bcas pa/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshig don gter gyi spa bskang mchod byang bkod pa me tog chun po'i phreng ba rgyan ldan/ mchod pa'i sprin dpung zhes bya ba rang gzhung gi dkyil 'khor stong dang drug brgya la nges pas/ bshad byang rtogs pa dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ma'i dbang po yis/ byang gi sa gnas re khyu zhes bya bar/ shing sprel zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu drug gi nyin/ grub pa bgyis pa dge legs 'phel//
